description: A vulnerability was determined in SourceCodester School Registration and Fee System 1.0. The impacted element is an unknown function of the file /bilal/normal/delete_stud.php. Executing a manipulation of the argument selector[] can lead to sql injection. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized.
